# C# Development Instructions

## Purpose

Maintain code quality, consistency, and best practices in C# development.

## Instructions

- Follow .NET naming conventions and project structure.
- Use async/await for asynchronous code.
- Write XML documentation for public APIs.
- Avoid magic numbers and hard-coded strings.
- Use dependency injection for services.
- Ensure code is covered by unit and integration tests.
